messages.subject: Problem with running SuperZip Example
parts:
Colleagues,

I tried to run the Shiny - SuperZip example:

shiny::runGitHub("rstudio/shiny-examples", subdir="063-superzip-example")

However, the command returns the following error:

Downloading https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-examples/archive/master.tar.gz

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:4979
Error in get(method, envir = home) :
  lazy-load database '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library/htmlwidgets/R/htmlwidgets.rdb' is corrupt
Error : package or namespace load failed for ‘leaflet’
Warning in run(timeoutMs) : restarting interrupted promise evaluation
Warning in run(timeoutMs) : restarting interrupted promise evaluation
Warning in run(timeoutMs) : internal error -3 in R_decompress1

Following the error message I tried reinstalling the htmlwidgets:

> remove.packages("htmlwidgets")
Removing package from ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
> install.packages("htmlwidgets")
trying URL 'http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/snapshot/2015-05-01/bin/macosx/mavericks/contrib/3.2/htmlwidgets_0.3.2.tgz'
Content type 'application/octet-stream' length 711803 bytes (695 KB)
==================================================
downloaded 695 KB

But the error remains. I also tried reinstalling the leaflet package:

> remove.packages("leaflet")
Removing package from ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
> install.packages("leaflet")
Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘leaflet’ is not available (for R version 3.2.0)
> devtools::install_github('rstudio/leaflet')
Downloading github repo rstudio/leaflet@master
Installing leaflet
Skipping 1 packages ahead of CRAN: Rcpp
'/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/bin/R' --no-site-file --no-environ --no-save --no-restore CMD INSTALL  \
  '/private/var/folders/7x/kwc1y_l96t55_rwlv35mg8xh0000gn/T/RtmpZZIgk7/devtools48029d85fb0/rstudio-leaflet-0bcdd2d'  \
  --library='/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library' --install-tests

* installing *source* package ‘leaflet’ ...
** R
** inst
** tests
** preparing package for lazy loading
** help
*** installing help indices
** building package indices
** installing vignettes
** testing if installed package can be loaded
* DONE (leaflet)

But I keep on arriving at the same error, I will be grateful for any suggestions.

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Problem with running SuperZip Example
parts:
Two issues there:

1. (You have realized it) leaflet is not on CRAN yet (hopefully will
be soon-ish), so install.packages('leaflet') won't work, and you need
to install it here: https://github.com/rstudio/leaflet

2. I believe your scales package is not recent enough:
update.packages(ask = FALSE, repos = 'http://cran.rstudio.com') should
fix it.

Before you do these things, I recommend you to restart your R session.

Regards,
Yihui
